content.text: Check the following before beginning Troubleshooting.

content.description: Troubleshooting flowchart showing decision tree for trip computer diagnosis. Starts with checking if display cluster indicates 'EEEE', then disconnecting battery negative cable, checking for flashing 1:00 display, performing input data trip computer test, and branching to either OK or performing individual troubleshooting items.
labels: If DISPLAY CLUSTER indicates "EEEE", operation is wrong.
Disconnect the negative cable from the battery for 10 seconds and then, reconnect it.
Inspect circuit and voltage of Keyboard (See page BE-114)
Perform input date to trip computer again. Does trip computer operate correctly for all items?

rows:
MPG display is always zero.
Trip reading does increase or "ARRIVE" mode indicate "・・・・・・・" always.
MPG display is always 70 or trip reading does not change.
